unit.why: A single anecdote: on Rosh Hashana the aged tsaddik R. M. lost his strength while leading Musaf and was revived on hearing the fervent prayer of the Maggid of Mogielnica.

stories.start_quote: וגם שמעתי מהם שספרו כי פעם
stories.summary_en: On Rosh Hashana the aged R. M. lost all strength while leading the Musaf prayer and meant to step down, but he suddenly heard the fervent prayer of the rebbe of Mogielnica, his strength returned, and he finished the prayer.
